name: Ahimelech
description: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy

points: David asked Ahimelech the Hittite and Abishai the son of Zeruiah, the brother of Joab, Who will go down with me to Saul to the camp? and Abishai said, I will go down with thee; and they came to the people by night, and all lay sleeping.

note.label: 1 Samuel 26: David Spares Saul a Second Time
